title: Nelson’s pillar
html_source: The Nelson Pillar was a large granite pillar topped by a statue of Horatio Nelson. It was built in 1808-09 on Sackville Street (now O'Connell Street). The pillar was blown up by Irish nationalists in 1966 (the 50th anniversary of Easter Uprising). The Spire of Dublin was built on its former ground.
